title.en: When does a building use the Electric 30 fine-stone row?
title.zh: 建筑浇筑什么时候读电动30的细石行？

description.en: Read Electric 30 fine stone only for that printed line: 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, horizontal 60 m / vertical 180 m. The aggregate-13 line is shorter.
description.zh: 只有料对得上细石行才读电动30：30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m。13 骨料行更短。

h1.en: When does a building use the Electric 30 fine-stone row?
h1.zh: 建筑浇筑什么时候读电动30的细石行？

directAnswer.en: Use the Electric 30 fine-stone cells when the mix is the fine-stone line Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints in Xingtai: horizontal 60 m and vertical 180 m, beside 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and hopper 0.3 m³. The same page prints a second distance for aggregate 13: 20 m / 60 m, and maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Do not paste the 180 m vertical figure onto the coarser row.
directAnswer.zh: 料属于邢台河北品锦机械印出的细石行时，才用电动30的细石格：水平 60 m、垂直 180 m，旁边是 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³。同一页给 13 骨料另印了 20 m / 60 m，最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。不要把 180 m 垂直抄到较粗的那一行。

heading.en: Why are there two distance rows?

body.en: The table separates “fine stone pumping” from “aggregate 13 pumping”. Fine stone is 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical. Aggregate 13 is 20 m horizontal / 60 m vertical. Both sit under the same 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa cells. The machine frame is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. Building placement is the published scenario, not a named tower.
body.zh: 表把“细石输送”和“13 骨料输送”分开。细石是水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m。13 骨料是水平 20 m / 垂直 60 m。两行共用 12–15 m³/h 和 20 MPa。机架是 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。公布工况是建筑浇筑，不是一座有名字的楼。

heading.en: What if the stone is not fine stone?

body.en: Open the aggregate-13 row, or leave Electric 30 if the stone is above ≤ 3 cm. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints a fine-stone window of 80 m / 240 m at the same 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa, with a 37 kW motor, and it does not print an aggregate-13 distance. Do not invent that second row.
body.zh: 去读 13 骨料行；石子超过 ≤ 3 cm 就离开电动30。电动低压40在同样的 12–15 m³/h 和 20 MPa 下，细石窗口是 80 m / 240 m，电机 37 kW，并且没有印 13 骨料距离。不要替它编第二行。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Write “fine stone” or “aggregate 13”, plus the measured horizontal and vertical metres. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请写明是“细石”还是“13 骨料”，并附上量到的水平与垂直米数。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Can the 180 m vertical cell be used for aggregate 13?
question.zh: 180 m 垂直可以用于 13 骨料吗？

answer.en: No. Aggregate 13 is printed as 20 m / 60 m.
answer.zh: 不可以。13 骨料印的是 20 m / 60 m。

answer.en: No. It is an electric trailer pump. Spraying machines are on /products/spraying-machines.
answer.zh: 不是。它是电动拖泵。喷涂机在 /products/spraying-machines。

question.en: Does the page list a jobsite volume?

answer.en: No. 12–15 m³/h is the catalogue output cell.
answer.zh: 没有。12–15 m³/h 是目录输送量格。
